subject.title: Feature request: first-class .env / environment-backed secret config UX

question: What SecretRef source metadata may Control UI expose for env-backed secrets, and should env variable names or resolved/unresolved state be shown by default?
rationale: The requested UX improves credential hygiene, but exposing source/provider/id or availability can reveal operator environment details, so automation should not pick that boundary alone.

options.title: Conservative source-aware UI
options.body: Show masked source labels and configured/unset state, reveal env variable names only where maintainers approve, and keep writes aligned with existing SecretRef config/apply paths.

options.title: Minimal read-only badge
options.body: Replace generic structured placeholders with a safe SecretRef-configured badge while leaving source switching to Raw/CLI until a broader design is approved.

options.title: Defer UI disclosure
options.body: Keep current Control UI behavior and improve docs or CLI guidance until security review defines the metadata disclosure policy.

recommendation.title: Conservative source-aware UI
recommendation.body: Show masked source labels and configured/unset state, reveal env variable names only where maintainers approve, and keep writes aligned with existing SecretRef config/apply paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged history for the SecretRef round-trip and Control UI foundation is tied to this contributor path.
